title: claytonia meyeniana
intro: Claytonia meyeniana, commonly known as quinoa spinach or lampuyo, is a plant species native to the Andean region. It is a nutritious and edible plant, used as a leafy green vegetable, providing essential vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants. The health benefits of Claytonia meyeniana include its ability to aid in weight management, lower cholesterol levels, and improve cardiovascular health due to its high content of fiber, vitamins, and minerals. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic properties, attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
